# The Galunga Tour

> A competitive amateur golf circuit founded in 2014, based in the Dallas–Fort Worth area.

The Galunga Tour is a full-season amateur golf tour co-founded by Mickey Courtney and Justin Buchanan in 2014. The tour features nine annual events, 50+ members competing across 20+ courses, a season-long points race, and the annual Galunga Cup — a Ryder Cup-style team match play event. Events are played under USGA rules with GHIN net scoring.

## Pages

- [Home](https://galungatour.com/): Tour overview, upcoming events, and next event details
- [About](https://galungatour.com/about.html): Tour history, founders Mickey Courtney and Justin Buchanan, membership info, and how the points system works
- [Schedule](https://galungatour.com/schedule.html): 2026 tournament schedule, event details, entry fees, and season points race standings
- [Players](https://galungatour.com/players.html): 2026 player roster with rankings, team assignments, and player bios
- [Archive](https://galungatour.com/archive.html): Historical tournament results (2021–2025), champions by event, and all-time tour records
- [Contact](https://galungatour.com/contact.html): Contact information and social media links

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2014
- Members: 50+
- Events per season: 9
- Home course: Pecan Hollow Golf Course
- Email: thegalungatour@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/thegalungatour/
- Scoring: USGA rules, GHIN handicap net scoring
- Teams: Team Courtney vs. Team Buchanan (Galunga Cup)

## 2026 Season Events

1. Winter Open — Irving GC (Feb 28, completed)
2. Pick A Partner — Tangle Ridge GC (Apr 4)
3. The Galunga Masters — Bridlewood GC (May 9–10, Major)
4. SNRE Harambe Memorial — Waterchase GC (Jun 20)
5. The Galunga Open — Firewheel (Jul 25–26)
6. Team Throwdown (Aug 29)
7. Match Play Championship (all season)
8. Galunga Tour Championship (Major)
9. The Galunga Cup — Pine Dunes Resort (Nov 6–8)

## All-Time Records

- Low Round (Gross): 66 — Daniel Dodd, Tangle Ridge
- Most Tour Wins: Eric Anderson
- Most Championships: Eric Anderson
- Lowest Season Avg.: Eric Anderson
